title: Home Purchase Financing Returned-Payment Fee — Amount Clause
content:
**Amount of the returned-payment fee on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

The returned-payment fee is the return channel charge times the return repeat multiplier, plus the return reason charge, rounded half up to the cent once on that sum.

- The return channel charge is the program's returned-payment fee, as the program fee schedule shows.
- Returns are counted over the 12 whole months before the fee date, a return counting when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the fee date.
- The return repeat multiplier is 1.
- The return reason charge is zero.

### Worked figure (hypothetical program fee of 30.00)

The return channel charge 30.00, times the return repeat multiplier 1, is 30.00; plus the return reason charge of zero, the fee is 30.00, and rounding half up to the cent leaves 30.00.

### Which returns are counted (hypothetical fee date 2026-05-20)

| Date of an earlier return | Whole months between it and the fee date | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-11-02 | 6 | yes |
| 2025-05-21 | 11 (and 29 days) | yes |
| 2025-05-20 | 12 | no |
| 2024-12-10 | 17 | no |
